facts.fact: In its national statement to the 29th session of the UN CSTD (Geneva, 20-24 April 2026), The Gambia says it is currently developing a National AI Policy and Strategy, led by the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy; the statement carries no date of its own, so the as_of is the document's published date (2026-04), a proxy from the session dates.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy
